column1: # Arabic (ar) interface catalog. English source<TAB>translation; \n denotes a line break.
# Write every translation in normal typing (logical) order, as you would in any editor. The
# catalog is put into display order when it loads (crates/ui-egui/src/bidi.rs), because egui lays
# words out left to right; never reorder words by hand here. `{name}` and `{}` placeholders must
# appear in both columns, and keyboard-shortcut text (Ctrl+, Alt+, ⌘) stays as it is.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# Arabic computing vocabulary (Modern Standard Arabic, Western digits). No Microsoft PowerPoint (or
# other product) localisation, string table or translated UI was consulted or copied; add entries
# the same way. Product, format and technology names (DeckCraft, PDF, PPTX, SmartArt, WordArt,
# Discord, GitHub ...) and key names (Tab, Backspace, Esc) stay in Latin letters.
# Counts use count-neutral wording (`الشرائح: 21`), so no plural forms are needed.
# Terminology: Slide = شريحة, Presentation = عرض تقديمي, Slide Show = عرض الشرائح, Layout = تخطيط,
# Theme = نسق, Slide Master = الشريحة الرئيسية, Placeholder = عنصر نائب, Transition = انتقال,
# Animation = حركة, Section = قسم, Notes = ملاحظات, Handout = نشرة, Comment = تعليق,
# Chart = مخطط بياني, Table = جدول, Shape = شكل, Picture = صورة, Outline = مخطط تفصيلي,
# Hyperlink = ارتباط تشعبي, Ribbon = الشريط, Pane = جزء, Dialog = مربع حوار.
